trend: New review of 12 RCTs: oral magnesium is not a routine treatment for insomnia
why: Freshest sleep story this month; a doctor's 'deinfluencing magnesium' video is doing the rounds too.
text:
A new review of 12 trials says magnesium on its own isn't a reliable fix for insomnia.

Fair. It's why SILT Nights runs on 3 g glycine for falling asleep, with 250 mg magnesium there for recovery and ashwagandha for stress. Every dose is printed on the pack.
